source_dir: raw_all/Mental health in tech survey: Raw data 2014-2018
description: OSMI Mental Health in Tech Survey 2017+2018 combined — tech workers on workplace mental health
note: Pre-LLM era — all responses guaranteed human-written. 534 respondents have >=80 total chars across text fields.

Q_EC.label: Describe the conversation you had with your employer about your mental health, including their reactions and what actions were taken to address your mental health issue/questions.

Q_CC.label: Describe the conversation with coworkers you had about your mental health including their reactions.

Q_CW.label: Describe the conversation your coworker had with you about their mental health (please do not use names).
Q_CW.note: Coworker shared their mental health with you

Q_PE.label: Describe the conversation you had with your previous employer about your mental health, including their reactions and actions taken to address your mental health issue/questions.

Q_PC.label: Describe the conversation you had with your previous coworkers about your mental health including their reactions.

Q_CA.label: How has being identified as a person with a mental health issue affected your career?
Q_CA.note: Career impact of mental health disclosure

Q_BH.label: Describe the circumstances of the badly handled or unsupportive response.

Q_SH.label: Describe the circumstances of the supportive or well handled response.

Q_ID.label: Briefly describe what you think the industry as a whole and/or employers could do to improve mental health support for employees.

Q_AE.label: If there is anything else you would like to tell us that has not been covered by the survey questions, please use this space to do so.
